grasp_0.description: this grasp point is located on the rim of the mug

grasp_1.description: this grasp point is located on the handle of the mug

plane_0.description: The first plane is a horizontal plane defined by the rim of the mug. Its centroid is located at the geometric center of the circular opening of the rim

plane_1.description: The second plane is also a horizontal plane defined by the base of the mug. Its centroid is positioned at the geometric center of the mug's bottom surface, and this plane is parallel to the rim plane.

plane_2.description: The third plane is a vertical plane defined by the handle of the mug. Its centroid is positioned at the geometric center of the mug's handle surface, and this plane is perpendicular to the rim plane and the base plane.

plane_3.description: This plane is a vertical plane for the front of the mug. Its normal is aligned with the handle of the mug, from the body of the mug to the handle of the mug.
